item.title: Search enters third day with no sign of Alabama River boater
item.description: The Alabama Law Enforcement Agency’s (ALEA) Marine Patrol Division is continuing its search for a Wetumpka man believed to be missing on the Alabama River.James Dawkins, 54, was reported missing after launching his boat near Shelton Landing at 5:30 a.m. Saturday. ALEA Cpt. Jeremy Burkett said Dawkins was in a Jon boat that was equipped with only a trolling motor.ALEA’s Aviation Unit has been searching the area since Saturday. item.description: A $14 million project to improve infrastructure along the Dauphin Street corridor near the Interstate 65 intersection will soon begin.The long-planned improvements and traffic safety enhancements will help reduce congestion on Dauphin Street, between Rimes Road and Sage Avenue.City officials said the section of roadway is of of the city's busiest commercial and residential corridors. item.description: For years, President Biden postured while Venezuela was collapsing.
